title: Values and functions
summary: Declare values, write a function, and return a computed result.

scenario.briefing: The advising portal formats student names and counts completed tasks. The helper returns undefined because it never returns a value. Fix the function.

objectives.description: Implement a function that returns a value.
Handle string and number values correctly.

hints: Declare a function with a parameter.
Build the result string with template literals.

misconceptions.description: Calling a function but forgetting to return.
misconceptions.testDescription: Returns a greeting with the name.
misconceptions.feedback: A function without return yields undefined. Add an explicit return.

misconceptions.description: Assigning without declaration creates a global.
misconceptions.feedback: Undeclared assignment leaks to the global object. Declare variables with const or let.

sections.title: Values and types
sections.body: JavaScript has strings, numbers, booleans, null, undefined, objects, and arrays. const declares a binding that cannot be reassigned; let declares a mutable one.

sections.title: Functions
sections.body: A function packages a computation. Parameters receive inputs and return sends a value back to the caller. Without return, the result is undefined.

vocabulary.definition: A declaration that cannot be reassigned.
A named input to a function.
The value a function sends back.
